_comment: Tool-selection eval cases. Each case states the prompt a principal types, the file kind in play, and which candidate MUST win the ranking. `forbidden` names candidates that must not win — the Python-backed skills that produced the Ministry's 0/5 on 2026-07-21. Prompts P1-P5 are VERBATIM from `incoming-tests/ClawX Agent Tests/Prompt Tests.docx`; P6 is verbatim from CHAT-001-6.png. The A-series are adversarial variants that use the exact vocabulary the competing SKILL.md descriptions advertise, because a steering fix that only survives the literal five prompts is overfitted.

cases.prompt: Open the Staff Meeting Memo Draft document and summarize its main points in bullet form.
cases.raj_result: FAIL — agent asked for a file path, then offered to write a Python script

cases.prompt: Rewrite the Staff Meeting Memo Draft into a professional internal memo. Save the edited copy as Staff_Memo_Final.docx in the Output_Files folder. Do not overwrite the original.
Summarize the ICT Equipment Audit circular for a teacher who has only five minutes to understand it.
cases.raj_result: FAIL — read skills/pdf/SKILL.md, then uv pip install pdfplumber

cases.prompt: Open the Student Marks Gradebook workbook and read the marks and the grade scale.
cases.note: The read half of Raj's P4, split out so read and write are scored separately.

cases.prompt: Open the Student Marks Gradebook workbook. Calculate each student's average and assign a grade using the scale in the workbook or instructions. Save the updated copy as Marks_Updated.xlsx. Do not overwrite the original.
Open the Student Support Referral Form image and list each visible field and value. Mark any blank, missing, or unclear fields.
cases.raj_result: FAIL — told the principal to install Tesseract and run a terminal command

cases.prompt: Search the MoE Agent Testing Folder and list all Word, PDF, Excel and image files you can find.
cases.note: Discovery prompt, only in CHAT-001-6.png. No single tool is right, so expect_tool is null — the assertion is purely that no Python skill outranks the document.* family.
cases.raj_result: FAIL — "I couldn't find any files in that folder"

cases.prompt: I need you to edit this Word document and produce a professional memo with headings and a letterhead.
cases.note: ADVERSARIAL: 'Word document', 'memo', 'headings', 'letterhead' are lifted verbatim from the docx SKILL.md trigger list. This is the hardest docx case in the suite.

cases.prompt: Open the xlsx in my downloads, add a column, compute the formulas and clean up the messy rows.
cases.note: ADVERSARIAL: 'the xlsx in my downloads' is quoted verbatim in the xlsx SKILL.md description as a trigger example.

cases.prompt: Extract the text and tables from this .pdf circular for me.
cases.note: ADVERSARIAL: 'reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs' is the pdf SKILL.md's first trigger.

cases.prompt: Draft the term-two report as a Word file I can attach to an email.
cases.note: ADVERSARIAL: docx SKILL.md claims any 'report' asked for 'as a Word file'.

cases.prompt: This referral form is a scanned photo — read the fields off the image for me.
cases.note: ADVERSARIAL: the pdf skill advertises 'OCR on scanned PDFs'. The native path needs no OCR binary — the VLM reads the returned image.
